instruction: You are given a pipe template `/home/user/Desktop/pipe_base/`. Complete a 3D fully developed laminar-flow analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/pipe_laminar/`: - Build a 3D circular-pipe geometry (axisymmetric or full pipe), and set laminar properties - Configure inlet and outlet boundary conditions - Run until the flow is fully developed 2. Extract the outlet velocity profile and verify fully developed laminar characteristics. 3. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Outlet maximum velocity `u_max` - Format: `u_max` 4. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
